source_snapshot.procedure: From BMC console, use `ethtool -s <port> speed <speed> duplex full autoneg on` for 1G=1000 and 100M=100.
source_snapshot.criteria: BMC port speed changes successfully and its LED follows the different speed.
source_snapshot.script: Private bmc-port; 10 attended and 10 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; changes a user-supplied BMC_PORT to 1000 through insecure SSH, notes physical LED observation and management-disconnect risk, but lacks switch/recovery/restoration control.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at HIGH risk; map exact BMC/switch ports, validate supported speed/autoneg matrix, use independent recovery, correlate ethtool/switch/LED evidence and restore baseline.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Identifies the right tool and disconnection risk but assumes the primary transport, one speed and compatible peer negotiation without proving interface identity or rollback.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly treats the BMC management link as service-impacting and requires switch-side evidence plus physical LED observation.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Setting `speed 1000` while leaving autonegotiation on may advertise rather than force a single result depending on driver and peer. Success must be based on the negotiated local and switch state, not merely a zero ethtool exit status.

original_test_intent: Verify the approved BMC LAN port can transition between supported 1G and 100M configurations and that negotiated link plus the physical port LED correctly reflect each state, then restore the original network configuration.
original_method: Identify the exact BMC interface and switch peer, capture local/peer baseline and physical LED, prove an independent recovery path, apply one approved speed profile at a time from console, monitor bounded management reachability, compare ethtool and switch negotiation, obtain operator LED evidence, then restore exact baseline and revalidate both paths.
manual_activity: The network/BMC owner approves the exact interface, switch peer, profiles and recovery window; an operator observes the labeled physical LED and remains available on the independent console for rollback.
required_inputs: Initial local and peer link state
safety_requirements: Never guess the interface or switch peer
Do not change the only management path without recovery
Apply one approved profile at a time
Stop on flapping or recovery-path loss
Do not reboot or power-cycle as improvised recovery
Preserve logs and never auto-retry ambiguous link loss
agent_execution_scope: Validate recovery path and supported profiles
engineer_actions: Approve interface, peer, profiles and window
Observe physical LED for each speed

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The ethtool operation matches the state change but assumes 1G/full/autoneg and unsafe SSH without proving the BMC interface, peer compatibility, independent recovery or final restoration.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: From the independent BMC console, run vendor-approved `ethtool -s <BMC_PORT> speed <100|1000> duplex full autoneg <approved>` one profile at a time, verify local and peer negotiation plus LED, then restore captured baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both 100M and 1G intents and the 10/10-minute window remain; exact autoneg behavior is gated by the platform and switch contract.

modernized_recommendation.status: DUAL-END BMC LINK-SPEED AND LED TRANSITION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record interface/physical/switch identity, requested profile, pre/post local ethtool, switch negotiated state, reachability outage/recovery timeline, operator LED state and restored baseline for each approved speed.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds peer coordination, external reachability, physical correlation and reversible recovery around the management-link change.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A local command response cannot prove actual negotiation, peer agreement, usable management connectivity or the correct physical LED.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: LED meanings are platform-specific and may encode link/activity rather than speed; vendor LED behavior must be defined before a color/state claim.

project_override_considerations: The Project must specify whether autoneg remains on for both profiles, which LED state/color represents 100M and 1G, and whether shared/dedicated/failover BMC interfaces are in scope. Only one mapped interface may be changed per approval.
expected_evidence: Approval, target/interface/physical/switch mapping and supported profile matrix
Baseline local ethtool, switch and LED state
Each ethtool command/response and local readback
Switch negotiation plus independent reachability loss/recovery timeline
Timestamped LED observation for each speed
Restored baseline, preserved network/BMC logs, no-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target BMC port speed and associated LED behavior. Missing interface, peer and LED semantics are execution prerequisites, not competing objectives.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The interface/peer map, supported matrix and recovery path are obtainable project inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if the only management path would be changed without independent recovery or the port cannot be identified safely.

review_improvement: Makes a management-disrupting ethtool change a dual-end, externally observed and fully reversible link test rather than trusting a local exit status and guessed LED.
independent_technical_reasoning: Local ethtool settings, negotiated speed and physical LED are three separate observables. A driver may accept a request yet negotiate differently; the switch may hold an incompatible profile; the LED may represent activity rather than speed. The case must correlate all three while an independent path confirms the BMC remains recoverable.
